tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshul dang po gsum gyi don nyung ngu'i ngag gis ston par byed pa'i legs par bshad pa tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i rin po che'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha ratna wardhā ya/ srid gsum ro gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /ye shes chen po'i ros gang rdo rje'i gsung / /'gyur med dam tshig rdo rje'i thugs mnga' ba/ /zung 'jug dges mdzad rdo rje 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bdag med zhal gyi bdud rtsi mtho ris klung / /gang thugs bde 'byung ral par gnas bcas te/ /deng 'dir 'dzam gling 'dzin mar 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /'jigs bral chos skyong sras dang bcas la 'dud/ /de las 'ongs pa'i tshul chen dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /gang blo chos kyi rgya mtshor nyer sim nas/ /phrin las chu klung phyogs brgyar nyer son pa'i/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon brgyud par bcas rnams rgyal/ /gang de'i yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /mnga' mdzad mkhas kun dga' mdzad bzang po'i zhabs/ /slob mar bcas dang khyad par chos tshul 'di'i/ /bka' drin thob pa'i yongs 'dzin mchog gis skyongs/ /zab rgyas rgyud sde kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /rje btsun mched kyis phye ba'i legs bshad rnams/ /rang gi yid la yun ring goms pa dang / /skal mnyam gzhan la phan phyir tshul 'di spel/ /rnam gzhag mtshan gyi don dang bshad thabs dang / mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya tshul bzhi yin/ /dang po la ni thob bya thob byed gnyis/ /thob bya spangs rtogs mthar thug rdo rje'i sa/ /theg pa kun gyi gong ma de kho na/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi dbye ba mtha' yas phyir/ /'bras bu gcig tu rigs pa min zhe na/ /gnas skabs 'bras bur btags pa mang yod kyang / /chu klung du ma rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar/ /mthar thug 'bras bu thams cad chos skur gcig /de yi 'thad pa kha sbyor rgyud chen dang / /'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs na gsal bar bzhugs/ /rang rang thob bya'i 'bras bu la dmigs nas/

/so so'i thabs la slob pa lam zhes bya/ /de la mtshan btags dbye ba mang yod kyang / /re shig thun mong thun mong min pa gnyis/ /thun mong ngan 'gro bde 'gro thar pa tsam/ /thob byed lam gyi dbye ba rnam pa gsum/ /dang po 'jig rten rgyang 'phen 'dod pa ste/ /bar pa srid dang mu stegs mchog gi gzhung / /de dag thar lam min phyir btags pa ba/ /phyi ma nyan thos rang rgyal lam yin no/ sna tshogs gdul bya rjes su bkri ba dang / /lam dang gang zag gol sa gcad pa'i phyir/ /thun mong lam gyi rnam dbye dang por byas/ /kun mkhyen la dmigs theg chen 'jug ngogs ni/ /sdug bsngal spong dang srid la ma zhen dang / /thar pa'i lam rnyed zhi la'ang ma chags pa'i/ /chos lnga rang bzhin gsum dang rnam shes brgyad/ /bdag med gnyis dang chen po rnam bdun ldan/ /theg pa che la lam gsum lam gcig las/ /'bras bu gsum du 'dod dang lam gcig dang / /rnam gsum lam las 'bras bu gcig 'dod pa'i/ /bzhed tshul rnam bzhir yod kyang dang po gnyis/ /dgongs pa can dang gzhan gnyis nges don du/ /lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas nges par bya/ /gzhan las phul byung theg pa chen po la/ /dbye na pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags gnyis/ /de gnyis gdul bya dbang po rno rtul phyir/ /lam dang 'bras bu nye ring spyi sbas su/ /legs par grags shing lung dang rigs pas grub/ /de phyir theg chen spyi dang sngags zhes grags/ /'di dang mthar thug gcig tu bshad pa gnyis/ /'gal bar smra ba blo gros rtsing ba ste/ /rang rang gzhung nas bshad pa'i 'bras bu de/ de de'i thabs kyis thob par ma nges shing / /phar phyin lam gyi 'bras bu kun tu 'od/ /mthar thug 'bras bu min par rgyud mang dang / /zhal lung rtsa 'grel sogs na gsal bar bzhugs/ /theg chen rnam gnyis gzhi spong mi spong byed/ /gzhi sgra rgyu rkyen gnas dang kun sbyor dang / /yongs bzung ba de rnam lnga la 'jug kyang /

/skabs 'dir rkyen gyi rgyu ste 'dod yon lnga/ /de nyid thabs kyi dbye bas 'khor ba dang / /myang 'das gnyis ka bskyed phyir gzhi zhes bya/ /dang po yul myong de la mngon zhen skye/ /de las sna tshogs rnam rtog 'byung ba ni/ /ma rig sred len nyon mongs kun nyon mongs/ /de las las byed 'du byed srid pa ste/ /de dag las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa/ /de las 'gro ba drug tu rnam shes dang / /ming gzugs skye mched drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor dang skye ba rga shi zhes bya ba/ /rnam bdun skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs te/ /gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis kyis/ /yang srid rnams su 'khor zhing skye bar 'gyur/ /de la kun nas nyon mongs rten 'brel zer/ /thog mar yul myong de yi rang bzhin shes/ /de la mngon zhen bral bas ma rig 'gag /de bzhin rga shi'i bar du 'gag 'gyur te/ /rnam par byang ba'i rten 'brel zhes bya'o/ /de phyir yul gyi steng na 'ching grol rgyu/ /tha dad ngo bo nyid kyis mi gnas kyang / /rkyen gyis 'gyur bas 'ching dang grol bar byed/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las dang nyon mongs las/ /nyon mongs yul gyi dbye bas 'byung rtogs nas/ /yul la dug dang dgra ltar lta byed cing / /bral na bde ba'i 'du shes sgom par byed/ /tshul min yid byed sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / /thos dang bsam pas yul gyi rang bzhin dpyod/ /'dod chags mi sdug rnam rtog rlung bgrang dang / /zhe sdang byams pa gti mug rten 'brel lam/ /yang na don dam bsgoms pas thams cad spong / /'gro la snying rje chen pos kun bslangs nas/ /phyin bcu nyams su len pa phar phyin lam/ /theg chen rigs dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /mos pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song nas/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed sdom pas rgyud bsdams te/ /sbyin sogs thabs shes sgrub pa mos spyod sa/ /skyon med la 'jug mthong lam sa dang po/

/sems can yongs su smin byed sa bdun pa/ /zhing sbyong ba dang mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /rnam gnyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa gsum la/ /mngon par byang chub mya ngan 'das ston te/ /rnam bcu lam dang 'bras bu'i mngon rtogs so/ /phyin drug la brten srid zhi'i pha rol tu/ /bgrod phyir pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa ste/ /de nyid la brten brtson pa rab kyis kyang / /grangs med gsum sogs 'gor phyir rgyu'i theg pa/ /chags can thabs dang ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /yul rnams ye shes skye ba'i grogs yin phyir/ /'dod yon bsten bya nyid du rgyud las bsngags/ /yul nyid 'ching bar byed pa ma yin yang / /der brten phyin ci log gi rnam rtog gis/ /'ching phyir rnam rtog spong ba'i thabs kyi mchog /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par gyis/ /spang bya rim gyis spong zhing slar grogs byed/ /mtshan rtog skyob phyir de la sngags zhes bya/ /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin brlabs nas/ /lam dang 'bras bu bgrod phyir rdo rje'i theg /'bras bu'i rnam pa sgom dang 'bras bu la/ /nye phyir 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /mdo sngags rnam gnyis rtogs bya chos kyi dbyings/ /thob bya mthar thug 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun slong byang chub sems rnams mtshan nyid gcig /'on kyang khyab mnyam nyid du 'khrul mi bya/ /phar phyin lam gyi so skye'i gnas skabs su/ /rtog med ye shes bskyed min gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ye shes kyis/ /chos dbyings dpe yi tshul gyis dngos su rtogs/ /de la mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes zhes/ /rgyud gzhung kun las bsngags shing rang rig pa'i/ /ye shes yin (min )phyir rtog med nyid du 'thad/ /de yis mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyang / /myur du 'dren phyir ma rmongs lam zhes bya/ /thun mong lam gyi thabs mkhas ji snyed pa/ /de snyed steng du rim gnyis bzlas bsgom sogs/

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs/ /zab dang rgya che'i thabs tshul mang zhig ldan/ /phar phyin nas bshad bsgrub dka'i dka' spyad dang / /dka' thub drag pos lus sems mi gdung par/ /spyod pa bde bas 'grub phyir dka' ba med/ /skyon med sngags kyi thabs mkhas la brten pa'i/ /so skye yin yang brtson pa'i bye brag gis/ /'bras bu gzhan las myur phyir dbang po rno/ /'di bzhis mdo las gsang sngags khyad par 'phags/ /'di la sngon du gzhan gyis brgal ba'i tshul/ /rnam mang lan gyis spros pa dang bcas pa/ /tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung na gsal zhing rgyas/ rig byed tshad mar 'dod pa'i mu stegs byed/ /'dod khro gti mug cha mnyam spyod pa rnams/ /rim gyis drang phyir de dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /rgyud bzhi gsungs par kha cig bzhed ces grags/ /rang sde gnas ma bu rnams phung po las/ /gcig dang tha dad brjod med bdag 'dod ltar/ /bdag dang ras bris gnyis ka ma yin pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpar 'dod pa bya ba'i rgyud/ /bye mdo rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang / /shes pa skad cig cha med bden 'dod ltar/ /dam ye so sor 'dod pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /rang rgyal gzung yul bden par mi 'dod kyang / /'dzin byed shes pa bden par smra ba ltar/ /dam ye bsres nas slar yang ye shes pa/ /gshegs par 'dod pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs/ /dbu sems gzung 'dzin gnyis med 'dod pa ltar/ /dam ye dbyer med 'dod pa bla med de/ /bskyed chog rnam bzhis rgyud bzhir nges so zhes/ /sngon byon chen po 'ga' yis bzhed par grags/ /blta dgod 'khyud dang gnyis kyis gnyis sprad pas/ /'dod ('pho )chags tshim pa'i 'dod khams sems can la/ /de de'i bde ba tsam zhig rjes gnang ba'i/ /rgyud bzhir 'dod pa 'thad ldan legs pa'i lugs/ /dman 'bring mchog dang ches mchog gdul bya bzhis/ /rgyud chen rnam bzhir grangs dang go rim nges/

/lus ngag bya dang gnyis ka cha mnyam spyod/ /ting 'dzin gtsor byed ting 'dzin gong na med/ /ston phyir bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med zer/ /bla med yo gar bsdus nas rgyud gsum du/ /yo ga'i srol 'byed kun snying la sogs bzhed/ /de dag phyi dang gsang ba'i rgyud ces gsungs/ /bzhi ru bzhed rnams phyi nang gsang bar 'dod/ /de bzhin lnga dang drug tu 'dod rnams kyang / /dbye bsdu tsam las don la mi 'gal yang / /gang zag dbang dang lam bzhi'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /rgyud bzhir tshad ldan mkhas la grags shing grub/ /rnal 'byor che la thabs shes gnyis med gsum/ /de yi khyad par gleng gzhi'i yi ge dang / /bskyed rim lha dang rdzogs rim rnam pa gnyis/ /rjes spyod rnam dag rgyud kyi gdul bya rnams/ /rim bzhin mang nyung pho mo thabs shes sogs/ /gang gang gtso che thabs dang shes rab ste/ /de de gnyis ka ldan na gnyis med rgyud/ /yin phyir dgyes rdor gnyis med rgyud du grub/ /'di dag cung zad rags pa'i 'jog byed de/ /don gyis 'dus pa sogs kyang gnyis med du/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa che las bshad/ /de phyir 'di la klan ka'i go skabs ci/ /rgyud gang sngon byung bshad gzhi rtsa rgyud de/ /phyis byung 'chad byed rgyud rnams bshad rgyud yin/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud la rgyas bsdus rnam pa gnyis/ /bshad rgyud thun mong thun mong min par gnas/ /'di la gsal bar byed dang kha skong dang / /cung zad tshul mi 'dra dang don bsdus dang / /phan tshun nges skyed tshig don rnam phye bas/ /bshad pa'i rgyud du 'gyur tshul rnam drug las/ /'jog byed phal cher tshang na rtsa bshad yin/ /rgyud kun gzhi lam 'bras gsum bskyed rim dang / /de las ldog pa gang zag gzhug rim dang / /rang dgar 'jug pa dgag phyir dkrugs pa ste/ /bzhugs tshul rnam pa gsum du phal cher nges/ /mdo rgyas tshig dang don gyi rnam pa gnyis/

/sdeb sbyor tshigs bcad rkang bzhi par nges kyang / /lung la tshigs bcad rkang pa gnyis pa nas/ /brtsams te drug pa'i bar du bshad pas na/ /de dang mthun pas tshigs su bcad rnams bgrang / /tshig lhug tshegs bar dgu la rkang pa dang / /de bzhi tshigs bcad gcig tu byas la bgrang / /dgyes rdor rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum lnga ste/ /brtag pa so gnyis le'u sum khri pa/ /rtsa rgyud bsdus pa brtag pa gnyis pa yin/ /'di yi ngos 'dzin 'dod tshul mang yod kyang / /'bum lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa phyi ma gnyis/ /logs su phyung bar 'jigs bral yab sras bzhed/ /'di yi shes byed 'bum phrag lnga pa yi/ /tshig don bsdus pa rdo rje gur gyis ston/ /'bum bdun zhes pa gtso bo rtsa rgyud de/ /rtsa bshad gnyis kyis phye ba'i rtsa rgyud min/ /thig le skor dang ra li skor gsum rnams/ /'bum lnga las 'phros phyi ma'i rgyud du bzhed/ /thun mong min pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ rtsa rgyud rgyas bsdus kho na gsal byed yin/ /gzhan dang thun mong bshad rgyud sambu ṭa/ /'di yis rgyud sde 'bum phrag sum cu drug /gsal bar byed ces 'byor pa'i dbang po bzhed/ /da lta dngos su gzhan la phan 'dogs pa/ /brtag 1 gnyis gur2 dang mnyam3 sbyor sgyu drwa4 dang / /rdo rje gad5na bzhi mant+ra aṃ sa6 dang / /dgongs lung ma gtogs 'dus pa'i rgyud chen10 bzhi/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad rnam pa15 lnga/ /de nyid 'du16sa pa rdo rje rtse17 mo ste/ /zab don gces pa bsdus pa bcu bdun yin/ /'jigs byed rtog bdun sgrol ma rgya mtsho sogs/ /las tshogs rab 'byams ston pa'i rgyud mang dang / /rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis zhes grags pa/ /kun kyang rgyu10da 'dis gsal bar byed ces gsungs/ /rtsa bshad rnam gsum gang zag gzhug rim dang / /dkrugs dang skye ba'i rim par rim bzhin gnas/ /rtsa rgyud gleng gzhis mdor bstan dang pos rgyas/

/brtag pa phyi mas shin tu rgyas par bshad/ /gur ni le'u dang pos mdor bstan nas/ /le'u lhag ma bcu bzhis rgyas par bshad/ /kha sbyor gleng gzhis mdor bstan mtshan don gyis/ /cung zad rgyas dang dang pos rgyas par bshad/ /brtag pa lhag ma rnam dgus shin tu rgyas/ /phyi ma'i rgyud kyis tshig don phye ste bshad/ /rtsa rgyud tshigs bcad bdun brgya lnga bcu ste/ /'di yi mjug na rdzas sbyor sogs ston pa'i/ /tshigs bcad nyer bdun 'khor gyi yi rangs bcas/ /'bum phrag lnga pa'i mjug na lhag 8 mar bzhugs/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje gur la stong nyer lnga/ /kha sbyor nyis stong brgyad brgya phyed bzhi yin/ /tshul chen sngags kyi theg pa bsam yas kyang / /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ /rtog dang bya spyod gnyis ka thabs rgyud rnams/ /stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhir bsdus te bstan/ /sdom pa 'byung bar thabs rgyud bye ba phrag /drug dang ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug /phar phyin dung phyur lnga dang sa ya gcig /theg dman dung phyur phrag brgyad yin par bshad/ /'di dag so so'i mtshan gyi grangs nges te/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i grangs nges de las lhag /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes bshad pa/ /nyan thos mos pa dman rnams drang phyir te/ /theg chen lugs la dbye ba bsam mi khyab/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ji snyed pa/ /nyan thos rnams kyis rang rgyud par 'dod cing / /yo ga'i srol 'dzin shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ /dka' thub mdzad pa yan chad rang rgyud pa'i/ /mdzad par 'dod kyang dri med lung gis gnod/ /skyon med bla ma rnams kyi bzhed srol ni/ /grangs med bskal pa'i sngon du rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de yi gnas ni stug po bkod pa ste/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams sogs du ma zhig /nang du tshud pa me tog rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de 'dra du ma nang du tshud pa ni/ /rgya mtsho zhes bya longs sku'i phyag na gnas/

/de bzhin gshegs de 'khor gyi byang sems bcas/ /bzhugs pa'i gnas de 'og min stug po'i zhing / /de yi nang tshud mtha' dag sprul sku'i gnas/ /yin phyir gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta bar/ /so so'i gnas su sprul sku'i mdzad pa ston/ /rgyal rnams chos kyi sku las ma g.yos shing / /chos sku nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin rtag bzhugs la/ /de yi smon lam mdzad pa bsam yas phyir/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams tshad kyang mtha' yas mod/ /de ltar bshad 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i/ /'khor du gtogs pa'i sa bcu'i byang sems kyis/ /sems can smin dang zhing khams de tsam zhig /legs sbyangs dbang gis snang bar 'gal ba med/ /'di yi 'thad pa skyon med ngag las btsal/ /gnas der rgyal sras mi g.yo'i bsam gtan la/ /zhugs tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis yongs bslangs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gsung gcig tu/ /phyi yi mngon byang zhes pa bskyed chog dang / /rjes su mthun pa'i sngags kyi lung phog cing / /byang chub sems dpa' des kyang mnyam bzhag pas/ /mngon byang ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs sku bdag nyid legs par mthong / /de nas de bzhin gshegs kun thugs zhugs pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig gyur mngon byang lnga/ /brtan par mdzad pa de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /thams cad mnyam nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /ye shes 'byung gnas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de ltar mngon byang thog mthas chos sku dang / /gnyis dang gsum pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bzhi pas sprul pa'i sku mchog grub par bshad/ /gzhan dag de lta'i mngon byang go rim ste/ /de nas thugs ka nas byung sangs rgyas kyis/ /dbang bzhi bskur bas sku bzhi thob par 'dod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang gis ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje chos kyis longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang gis chos kyi sku/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang gis sprul sku ste/

/gsang ba bzhi yi dbang gis byang chub thob/ /de nas de la ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /sku gsum dbyer med rnam snang mdzad chen 'gyur/ /de dang rnam snang chos dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung ste/ /longs sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung zer/ /sprul pa'i sku la gnyis ka yod par bshad/ /phyi yi mngon byang bgrod dang lhan cig tu/ /nang gi mngon byang nye rgyu'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /yul chen rnams kyi rlung dang byang chub sems/ /dbu mar stobs su gyur te rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /'di yi rnam dbye rgyud kyi mngon rtogs na/ /ji ltar bzhugs bzhin phyogs tsam 'dir nges bya/ /'og min gnas der ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bdag nyid can/ /gang de sprul pa'i tshogs dang rang rgyud pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs dang sa bcu'i byang sems kyi/ /'khor mang dbus su rtag par theg chen gyi/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad/ /longs sku 'og min gnas las mi bskyod kyang / /chu dang nam mkhar zla gzugs snang ba bzhin/ /tha dad gnas su grub pa'i gdul bya la/ /sprul sku mchog tu bstan nas theg chen ston/ /sngags kyi rgyud sde kun kyang tshul des gsungs/ /de ltar ston pa longs sku gcig po de'i/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i shugs dang smon lam gyis/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs de srid du/ /rab 'byams zhing gi gdul bya ji snyed pa/ /de snyed mdun du thabs tshul sna tshogs kyis/ /bsam yas mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par ston/ /khyad par sprul pa'i sangs rgyas zas gtsang sras/ /'dzam bu gling 'dir bskal pa bzang po la/ /'jig rten mthun par byang chub tshul bstan te/ /thun mong dag tu mdzad pa du ma ston/ /de yi 'khor du gnas pa'i rigs can gsum/ /tshogs lam chen po yan la gnas par bshad/ /khyad par 'khor gyi gtso bo sdud pa po/

/ston pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las/ /gzhan ngor sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /'og min gnas dang me tog rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mi mjed zhing dang khyad par mi yi ngor/ /rim bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang / /gsang ba'i bdag po kun dga' bo zhes grags/ /rigs can gsum la chos 'khor rim pa gsum/ /tha dad gnas su rim bzhin bskor min yang / /sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa bsam yas kyis/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i gdul bya la/ /so so'i snang ngor mdo sngags chos 'khor bskor/ /de phyir ston pas cig car gsungs mod kyang / /gdul bya'i mos pa dman mchog bye brag gis/ /chos 'khor rim dang cig car so sor snang / /'on kyang gnas tshul cig car nyid du nges/ /gsang rgyud mtha' dag grub pa'i gdul bya la/ /sprul sku mchog gis sngon du gsungs zin yang / /de nyid 'dus dang bde mchog ma gtogs pa/ /phal cher shākya thub pa rang nyid dang / /de yi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis bzlas te gsungs/ /gal te thub pa'i sngon du sngags kyi lam/ /yod na 'dus pa'i rgyud dang 'gal snyam na/ /de ni chos de'i che ba brjod pa tsam/ /yin gyi gsang sngags theg pa dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa nges pa'i don/ /'on kyang ston pa'i ye shes gcig yin phyir/ /shākya'i mtshan sogs 'byung ba 'gal ba med/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bsdu ba rnam gsum las/ /dang po dri med theg pa'i phug ces par/ /skyon bral dgra bcom brgya phrag lnga 'dus nas/ /sde snod rnam gsum 'phags pa gsum gyis bsdus/ /de rjes gnyis dang gsum pa'ang rim bzhin byung / /de bzhin theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams kyang / /lho phyogs dri med 'byung gnas zhes bya bar/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun bye ba phrag /dgu bcu 'dus nas bsdus zhes 'ga' zhig bzhed/ /'on kyang theg chen mtha' dag sdud pa po/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje yin/

/khyad par sngags kyi tshul rnams bsdus pa'i tshul/ /'di la log par rtog pa gzhan yod kyang / /skyon med bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /o ḍi ya na'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /legs par bcug nas yongs su smin par mdzad/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rjes rgyud kun bsdus/ /nges pa'i don du ston dang sdud pa po/ /tha dad med kyang dman la de ltar snang / /slar yang gsang ba'i bdag pos rgyud sde kun/ /gnas der rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la byin/ /de nas 'jig 'chags dbang gis yul phyogs de/ /rgya mtshor gyur pa'i klu rnams smin mdzad de/ /rgyud kun yi ger bris nas glegs bam rnams/ /lag 'gro'i tshogs la byin nas rgyas par mdzad/ /de rjes klu las gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams las bi su kalpa sogs/ /grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis legs blangs te/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang / /skyes mchog rnams kyis yongs su dar bar mdzad/ /rnam gzhag gong ma'i bzhed gzhung ji bzhin du/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i blo yis nges byas te/ /rnam dbye legs par bgyis pa'i dge ba de/ /rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po thob phyir bsngo/ /rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa'i don bsdus pa ste/ rim par phye ba dang po'o// ༈ //mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis mnga' mdangs rab gsal ba'i/ /mtshan rtog nyer zhi de la phyag bgyis nas/ /mtshan tsam shes pas rgyud kyi don rtogs pa'i/ /mtshan don mkhas pa'i srol bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /rang sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /gang de'i rang bzhin brjod pa kun bral yang / /mtshan nyid gsal zhing rig pa rgyun chags pa/ /de la brjod bya don gyi rgyud ces bya/ /'ga' zhig dbyings kyi ngos nas don rgyud ces/ /smra'o de dag brjod bral chos kyi dbyings/ /brjod byar bsgrub pa gad mo'i gnas min nam/

/gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo bo dbyer med kyang / /gnas skabs ldog tshul dbye bas rnam pa gsum/ /gdod nas spros bral dri bcas rang gi sems/ /rkyen gyis 'bras bu skye rung rgyu rgyud de/ /rgyu de 'bras bur 'byin byed rkyen gyi chos/ /smin grol lam gyi nyams len thabs kyi rgyud/ /thabs des glo bur dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /yon tan mngon du gyur pa 'bras rgyud yin/ /bye brag so so'i rgyud kyi mtshan rnams kun/ /phal cher rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes las/ /brtsams te btags nas shugs kyis gzhan gnyis la'ang / /'bras bu'i mtshan gyis btags pa shin tu mang / /'ga' zhig thabs dang 'bras bu las btags shing / /de bzhin zhu ba po dang gzhung tshad sogs/ /rjod byed sgo nas btags pa'ang 'ga' zhig mthong / /khyad par dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud rnams ni/ /sems can don la dges pa'i snying rje dang / /dmigs med shes rab mchog gi rdo rje che/ /gnyis min zung du 'jug pa 'bras rgyud mtshan/ /yin phyir gzhung lam rgyu la'ang de sgras bstan/ /rang bzhin dgyes rdor gsal stong zung 'jug rgyu/ /nyams len dgyes rdor thabs shes zung 'jug lam/ /'bras bu dgyes rdor sku gnyis zung 'jug rnams/ /ngo bo dbyer med yon tan gnas gyur nyid/ /rgyu rgyud rang bzhin rtog pas mi rdzi zhing / /thabs rgyud glo bur rnam rtog spong bar byed/ /'bras rgyud glo bur rnam rtog las grol phyir/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes byar mtshan gyis btags/ /de bzhin yang dag sbyor ba'ang 'bras bu'i mtshan/ /'phags pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyud ces pa/ /spang bya sdig pa'i phyogs las ring 'phags shing / /chos sku mkha' ltar mi rtog mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /gzugs sku rdzu 'phrul bkod pas mkhar 'gro zhing / /rdo rje dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab dang / /gur ni phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes che/ /brtag pa zhes bya rtog pas btags pa ste/

/gtso cher 'bras bu'i ngos nas btags pa yin/ /brjod bya rgyud gsum ston pa'i rjod byed kyi/ /ming tshig yi ge'i rnam pa rnam rig la/ /sgra don 'dres mar snang ba gang yin pa/ /de ni rjod byed sgra rgyud mtshan nyid pa/ /sgra rgyud blo la gnas pa'i 'bras bu dang / /don de rgyud la skyed pa'i grogs yin phyir/ /skye 'phags nyan bshad byed pa'i ngag tshig dang / /glegs bam la sogs sgra rgyud btags pa ba/ /ming tshig yi ge gzugs sam 'du byed du/ /mngon pa'i gzhung las bshad phyir sgra yi rgyud/ /rnam rig snang bar 'jog pa 'gal snyam na/ /nyan thos sde gnyis de ltar khas len kyang / /theg chen kun la kun rdzob snang ba kun/ /rnam rig sgyu ma lta bur 'dod de'i phyir/ /'og ma'i gzhung dang 'gal yang nyes pa med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'khor gyi byang sems kyis/ /chos kyi longs spyod rgyud kun sgra rgyud dang / /sngar bshad sgra rgyud mtshan btags ming can kun/ /btags par 'dod pa thun mong min pa'i lugs/ /brjod bya gnyis med ye shes don gyi rgyud/ /dgos pa rgyud gsum nyams su len pa ste/ /nying dgos rgyud gsum dbyer med mngon du gyur/ /thabs dang thabs byung rgyu 'bras 'brel ba 'o// //'dir smras pa/ rgyu rgyud thos bsam sgom pa'i yul gyi mchog /thabs rgyud lta sgom spyod pas legs sbyangs pas/ /'bras rgyud spangs rtogs mdzad pa mthar phyin te/ /sgra rgyud 'dzin skyong spel phyir dge 'di bsngo/ /rgyud kyi mtshan don bshad pa'i skabs kyi don bsdus pa ste/ rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o// ༈ //gsang gsum dbyer med mgon la phyag bgyis te/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa gzhan la ma grags pa'i/ /gsang rgyud kun gyi bshad thabs man ngag mchog /gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyan 'di mdo tsam dbye/ /bshad bya spyi dang sbas pa mthar thug gsum/ /'chad byed yan lag yi ge man ngag gis/

/gsal bar byed 'di gdams ngag rnam drug ces/ /bshad thabs kun gyi nang nas rgyal po nyid/ /spyi zhes bya ba gnyis ka'i thun mong ste/ /phyin drug byang phyogs lam lnga sa bcu sogs/ /mdo sngags thun mong brjod bya gang yin pa/ /de la pha rol phyin dang spyi zhes brjod/ /smin byed bum pa'i dbang dang rjes 'brel ba'i/ /bskyed rim lam gyi yan lag dang bcas la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa po/ /gnyis kas slob phyir bskyed rim spyi zhes bya/ /sbas pa zhes bya de la ma grags pa/ /gong ma'i dbang bskur thob pa'i khyad chos te/ /rtsa yig rlung dang gtum mo rang byung sogs/ /gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel ba'i brjod bya'i tshogs/ /mtha' dag rang byin brlabs pa'i sbas pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab rdo rje padma dang / /byang chub sems dang dga' bzhi lhan skyes sogs/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dang rjes 'brel ba/ /kun kyang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sbas par brjod/ /snying po ye shes rlung sogs bzhi pa dang / /rjes su 'brel rnams de las gzhan min phyir/ /phal cher dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sbas par bsdu/ /mthar thug ces pa lam de'i 'bras bu ste/ /spyi don mthar thug mdo sngags thun mong ba'i/ /'bras bur bshad pa'i kun tu 'od sa dang / /sbas don mthar thug rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /lam gyis thob pa'i bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa/ /kun tu 'od sa mthar thug dngos min yang / /de dang nye phyir mthar thug ming gis btags/ /des na pha rol phyin par ma bshad pa'i/ /sku dang ye shes shes bya mkhyen tshul sogs/ /sngags kyi gzhung las 'byung rnams sbas don no/ /dngos bstan ming dang tshig gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rgyud kyi tshig don 'chad pa yan lag don/ /yi ge las byung ming la dngos btags gnyis/ /mtshan nyid rgyu mtshan med dam yod kyang rung / /thog mar sbyar ba nam mkha'i nyi ma sogs/ /'jig rten kun la grags dang snang byed sogs/

/bstan bcos mkhan la grags rnams dngos ming dang / /rgyu mtshan dgos pa dngos la gnod byed de/ /chos gsum sgo nas de min der brjod pa'i/ /phyi nas sbyar ba phal cher btags ming yin/ /dngos ming rgyu mtshan med pa'i 'dod rgyal dang / /rgyu mtshan can gyi ming kun btags ming du/ /nges par 'chad la sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtshan/ /btags ming nyid du thal ba'i nyes pa yod/ /de phyir de gnyis 'dod rgyal rjes sgrub tu/ /'chad pa yod kyang phyogs re'i nges pa med/ /de phyir sgra de 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /yod med skabs dang bstun pa'i bshad pa bya/ /ming rnams tshogs pa las byung tshig gi don/ /dngos bstan ji bzhin rtogs par ma nus na/ /tshig gi 'byed sdud rnam dbye byed tshig sogs/ /legs par phye nas seṅge'i lta stangs dang / /sbal pa'i 'phar ba rus sbal bzhi 'gros dang / /stag mo'i mchongs stabs rnam bzhis gzhung don blang / /yang na dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don mtshams sbyar brgal lan bcas te bsnyad/ /de ltar bshad kyang gzhung don mi rnyed pa/ /'ga' zhig yi ge'i don gyis bshad bya ste/ /na dang ga ha dang po zhes sogs kyis/ /na ra ga wi ha sti sogs 'dren pa/ /yi ge'i sgra las drangs pa'i bshad pa dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i hūm̐ zhes pa/ /ha yig sgra las gra ha ka gzung ba/ /gra ha tsa zhes bya ba 'dzin pa dang / /zhabs skyed sha la byin pas shū n+ya tā/ /klad kor ma ni ma no ta ste yid/ /ces sogs yi ge kha phral bshad pa dang / /e waṃ ma ya zhes bya 'khor lo bzhir/ /dngos su bshad du med kyang dbyibs mthun gyis/ /'chad phyir yi ge dbyibs mthun bshad pa zer/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rnams na yig don gyi/ /bshad pa 'di dag 'jug pa ches mang yang / /phal cher brda sprod gzhung la rag las phyir/ /tshul de bslabs nas 'dir yang nges pa bskyed/ /yan lag yi ge gnyis kas rtogs min pa'i/

/ma da na chang ba la sha zhes sogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis brda mdzad pa/ /mtha' dag bsdus pa'i don gyi man ngag yin/ /de dag so so'i dper brjod mtha' yas shing / /'ga' zhig dkyus na gsal phyir 'dir ma bkod/ /spyi sbas mthar thug rim bzhin yan lag gi /don gyis bshad pa ji bzhin sgra dang ni/ /nges pa'i don dang dgongs min bshad pa zer/ /de gsum yi ge man ngag gis bshad na/ /rim bzhin ji bzhin sgra min rgyud don dang / /dgongs pa'i bshad pa yin phyir mtha' drug dang / /yig don zhes pa 'thad so'i bshad pa dang / /spyi sbas mthar thug bzhi la tshul bzhi zhes/ /bshad pa kun kyang gdams ngag drug tu 'dus/ /mdor na bshad bya'i dbye ba lnga'am drug /'chad byed gsum gyis phye bas 'chad tshul gyi/ /man ngag bco lnga bco brgyad gang 'dod 'byung / /brjod bya spyi sbas mthar thug rnam pa gsum/ /so sor ston pa'i gzhung tshig gang dang gang / /gzhung don yan lag bshad pa gtso che ba'i/ /'chad byed skabs su gang babs de dang des/ /khre'ur 'chad pa yongs grags bshad pa yin/ /zab cing rgya che ston pa'i gzhung tshig 'ga'/ /spyi sbas mtha' gsum tshang ba'i 'chad lugs kyis/ /rgyud don yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'chad pa/ /gang de 'jigs bral brgyud par bcas rnams kyi/ /thun mong min pa'i bshad srol yin zhes bya/ /rang bzhin rnam dag phung khams skye mched rnams/ /smin grol zab mo'i thabs kyis goms byas pas/ /mchog dang thun mong 'bras bu thob tshul gyi/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i mngon rtogs rnam gsum du/ /rgyud kyi tshig don mtha' dag legs bsdus nas/ /gang zag gcig gi nyams len mngon rtogs la/ /sbyar te 'chad pa rgyud gsum bshad pa ste/ /tshul 'di mngon par rtogs pas gsal bar byed/ /bshad thabs 'dis kyang khre'ur 'chad pa dang / /tshig 'ga' rgyud gsum tshang bar 'chad mod kyang / /phal cher snga ma'i rigs pas rtogs par nus/

/lus dang bum dbang sprul sku dbyibs bdag nyid/ /ngag dang gsang dbang longs sku sngags bdag nyid/ /sems dang gsum pa chos sku dbang chos bdag /rlung dang bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /mthar thug chos zhes bya ba bzhir bshad kyang / /chos gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rnam gsum rgyu dbang lam dang 'bras bur ldan/ /'dir yang bdag nyid can gsum khre'u dang / /sngags dbyibs chos gsum tshang ba'i tshig re re'ang / /rgyu dbang lam dang 'bras bu bzhis phye ba'i/ /'chad tshul bcu gnyis bcu drug gang 'os sbyar/ /'bras bu longs sku sbyang gzhi nying mtshams sbyor/ /gsang dbang rang byin brlabs pa gong bur gnas/ /de bzhin chos sku mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga/ /gsum pa'i dbang dang pho nya chu ru gnas/ /sprul sku 'tsho ba'i gnas skabs bum dbang dang / /bskyed rim lha sku'i rnam pa gzugs su gnas/ /ngo bo nyid dang 'chi ba'i gnas skabs dang / /bzhi pa'i dbang lam gzugs las 'das pa ste/ /re re'ang rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum gyis bsdus/ /de bzhin bskyed rim la sogs lam bzhi po'i/ /nang gses kun kyang gnas pa bzhi bzhi yin/ /'chad tshul 'di la'ang gnas pa rnam pa bzhi/ /gzhung tshig so sos khre'ur 'chad pa las/ /bzhi char gcig gis ston pa mi 'byung mod/ /'on kyang rgyu lam 'bras bu'i gnas pa gsum/ /gzhung tshig gcig la sbyar nas 'chad rung phyir/ /phal cher rgyud gsum sgo nas bshad dang mtshungs/ /chos kun gdod nas ma skyes de bzhin nyid/ /'gro kun bzhin lag rnam pa lha so so/ /cir snang rang sems snang ba rang rig pa/ /rgyu rgyud ngo bo nyid kyi dag pa gsum/ /sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba de bzhin nyid/ /bskyed rim lha sku'i rnam pa lha so so/ /rdzogs rim bde chen ye shes rang rig pa/ /thabs rgyud dri ma sbyong byed dag pa gsum/ /sgrib bral ngo bo nyid sku de bzhin nyid/ /gzugs sku zhal phyag rnam pa lha so so/

/chos sku rtogs pa ye shes rang rig pa/ /dri bral 'bras bu'i dag pa rnam gsum yin/ /'dir yang dag pa rnam gsum gzhung gi tshig /so so'i thad sor khre'ur 'chad pa las/ /gzhung tshig gcig la sbyar ba mi 'byung yang / /rgyu lam 'bras bu'i dag pa rnam gsum du/ /'chad du rung ba'i gnas skabs mang yod phyir/ /'chad tshul 'di yang snga ma nyid dang mtshungs/ /gsang ba mi gsal de nyid mdor bstan dang / /sa bon lnga dang dam pa'i dngos po sbas/ /gsang ba'i padma lte ba'i dga' ba dang / /kun tu 'gro dang bde ba mtha' yas de/ /gsang ba brgyad las thog mtha'i gsang ba gnyis/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs rgyu 'bras gnas lugs su/ /ngo bo gcig phyir gsang ba bdun du 'gyur/ /de dag rim bzhin rgyu dang smin byed dbang / /bskyed rim rtogs pa'i lta ba pho nya dang / /rang byin brlabs dang lam gyi yan lag ste/ /thob bya'i 'bras bu dang po'i shugs kyis ston/ /'dir ni gzhung kun khre'ur 'chad pa las/ /bshad thabs mang po sbyar ba mi 'byung phyir/ /'chad tshul 'di ni rgyud kyi mngon rtogs mtshungs/ /mi thub zla ba'i rgyud don yan lag lnga/ /ye shes zhabs kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bcas/ /bde mchog nyung ngu'i gsang ba rnam gsum rnams/ /phal cher 'chad tshul 'di dang mthun par bzhed/ /gzhung tshig gcig la spyi sbas mthar thug sogs/ /'chad thabs du ma sbyar ba'i 'chad tshul de/ /deng sang rgyud tshig kun la mi snang yang / /gleng gzhi la sogs dka' ba'i gnad 'ga' la/ /mang por bshad par kun la snang ba bskyed/ /gzhung tshig khre'ur bshad pa'i 'chad tshul des/ /bshad pa'i rnam grangs du ma mi ston yang / /rang rang skabs su gang babs bshad lugs kyis/ /rgyud kyi dbu zhabs mtha' dag 'chad nus phyir/ /phyogs re'i bshad par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa med/ /'phags skor la grags rgyan bdun zhes bshad pa/ /kun kyang bshad pa'i srol 'dir don gyis 'dus/ /'on kyang lugs 'di rgyud chen gzhan dag gi

/rjes su 'brang phyir ming tsam mi mthun yang / /mthar thug dgongs don gcig tu legs grub pas/ /gsung rab kun gyi tshig don ma nor bar/ /'chad pa'i tshul la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur// //'dir smras pa/ 'chad bya 'chad byed phyogs res ma khengs par/ /rin chen rin thang med pa'i sbyor thabs ltar/ /rgyud ni rgyud gzhan mang pos gsal byed pa'i/ /bshad thabs bshad pa'i dge ba 'gro la bsngo/ /rgyud kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag gi skabs kyi don bsdus pa ste/ rim par phye ba gsum pa'o// ༈ //swasti pra dzā bhyaḥ rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag mtshan don bshad thabs rnams/ /rgyud 'dzin mkhas pa'i srol bzhin bshad zin gyi/ /rgyud don shes par 'dod pa'i blo gros can/ /rgyud 'jam phrag dog med rnams 'di longs shig /yongs kyis ma rnyed legs bshad nor bu'i gter/ /yang dag tshig gi srad bu la brgyus te/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khang bzang mdzes byed 'di/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ /rnam dkar dge des bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /rnam dag bstan pa'i bya ba lhur byed cing / /rnam mang rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin te/ /rnam grol sku bzhi'i dbang phyug thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i tshul dang po gsum gyi don phyogs gcig tu ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i tshig don gyi cha ha cang ma spros shing / shin tu bsdus pa ma yin par/ skabs su bab pa'i ngag gis legs par bshad pa tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa rin po che'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams sgo du ma nas dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i slad du/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po ratna wardha'i zhal snga nas gtso bor smos pa'i chos bzhin du spyod pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras gzigs kyis 'tsho zhing /
